status_summary: On 2025-07-15 ACF's Office of Family Assistance posted a funding opportunity, READY4Life, with about $23.1 million for healthy marriage and relationship education for high-school-aged and young adult participants, alongside an adult-focused HEART opportunity of about $34.65 million. Neither listing mentions sexual risk avoidance. No change to CAPTA or Title IV-B law, no Title X requirement to give marriage information, and no specific protection for grantees' definition of marriage was found.

title: Use HMRE funds for high school marriage education; marriage information at Title X clinics
uncertainties: The READY4Life listing was re-read during review: it funds healthy marriage and relationship education for youth in grades 9 to 12 and ages 14 to 24 under Section 403(a)(2) of the Social Security Act, does not mention sexual risk avoidance, does not define marriage, and treats faith-based applicants on the same basis as others. The listing does not say whether it is new or a re-competition; a youth-focused HMRE grant line appears to have existed before 2025, so the 2025 opportunity may be a routine renewal rather than a change, which was not verified. The opportunities fund local grantees rather than state-level curricula. A Federal Register API search for Title X, family planning and marriage since 2025-01-20 returned no documents, and Title X notices of April 2026 tracked in c14-07 were not read for marriage content. Congressional action on CAPTA or Title IV-B was not searched. Confidence is capped by limited searching. Related teen pregnancy prevention redirection is tracked in c14-25.
